name: rescue_vs_resource_allocation_20260505100332_0
premise: In a small coastal town, a severe storm has caused a massive oil spill, threatening the local ecosystem and wildlife. Two rescue teams are dispatched to save the affected animals. One team, led by Sarah, believes in prioritizing immediate rescue efforts for the most endangered species. The other team, led by Tom, argues that they should allocate their limited resources to save a larger number of less endangered species. Both approaches have valid moral justifications, but the clock is ticking, and lives are at stake.

agents.name: sarah
agents.identity: A passionate environmentalist and wildlife rescuer.
agents.goal: I aim to save the most critically endangered animals, believing that their survival is paramount.

agents.name: tom
agents.identity: A pragmatic team leader focused on maximizing overall impact.
agents.goal: I want to save as many animals as possible, even if it means not saving the most endangered ones.

choices: I will focus on rescuing the critically endangered species, even if it means fewer total animals saved.
I will agree to help rescue a larger number of less endangered animals to maximize our impact.
